name: ONOSMODIUM VIRGINIANUM
key_symptoms: Sore, aching in breasts; feels swollen and sore. Pain in heart; pulse, rapid, irregular, weak.
Loss of memory. Nose feels dry. Confused. Dull, heavy, dizzy, pressing upward in occiput. Occipito-frontal pain in morning on waking, chiefly left side. Pain in temples and mastoid (Capsic).
Pain in back. Tired and numb feeling in legs, popliteal spaces, and below knees. Staggering gait. Sidewalk seems too high. Pain in left scapular region. Great muscular weakness and weariness.
Pain in dorsal and lumbar regions. Numbness and tingling in feet and legs.
